description: This file defines a handler for retrieving execution timeline data within a UI context, including caching, data aggregation over hourly periods, and API response formatting.

classes.name: ExecutionTimelineHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests related to execution timeline data, manages caching and data generation.

classes.name: ExecutionTimelineResponse
classes.description: Represents the JSON response containing timeline data, cache timestamp, and summary.

classes.name: TimelineDataPoint
classes.description: Aggregated execution data for a specific hour, including counts of success, failure, and running executions, durations, and notes.

classes.name: TimelineSummary
classes.description: Summary statistics for the execution timeline, including total executions, success rate, errors, and peak hour info.

classes.name: ExecutionTimelineCache
classes.description: Caches the execution timeline response for 5 minutes to optimize repeated API calls.

methods.name: NewExecutionTimelineHandler
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of ExecutionTimelineHandler with provided storage provider.

methods.name: GetExecutionTimelineHandler
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve execution timeline, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: generateTimelineData
methods.description: Generates hourly aggregated execution data for the past 24 hours by querying execution records.
